record.body:
## Problem

se-workflow and adaptive-artifacts each carry a version, but nothing checks that the adaptive-artifacts binary (or plugin) se-workflow resolved is compatible with this se-workflow release. Mismatched installs fail late or silently.

## Approach

Not yet scoped. Direction: expose AA version somehow, declare a compatible range from se-workflow, and refuse or warn when the resolved AA is outside it. Decide at discuss.

## Exit criteria

Not yet scoped. Decide at plan-phase after discuss settles the approach.
record.subject: version-compat-check
